v1.0.5 Update
- RollTable actions now offer Chat log or Private notification (only you). Chat is the default, including for existing actions without this setting, and follows normal table draw behavior and roll visibility. Private notifications do not mark results as drawn.

announcement.title: 🎨 Landing Page Maker v1.0.5
announcement.content:
Landing Page Maker v1.0.5

  • Choose Chat log or Private notification (only you) for RollTable actions in either editor. Chat is the default, including for existing actions without this setting, and follows normal table draw behavior and roll visibility. Private notifications do not mark results as drawn.
  • Cast updates keep unchanged content in place, and hidden sections receive the latest Actor values when opened.
  • Reduced unnecessary text-fitting and border-size calculations for hidden elements and section changes.
  • Connected portraits and Cast artwork now display with the configured framing for players without Actor sheet access. Sheet permissions and permissions for other linked Actor values are unchanged.
